lines.en: -Stop what? -You're talking about me and Morse code.
You know what? Joke's on you, 'cause I know Morse code.
In our very limited free time and with our very limited budget,
we went and got a nanny, and then we went out and took a class
on a very outmoded and very unnecessary form of communication
just so we could talk about you in front of you.
-It all started when Dwight was tapping his foot
against the leg of his desk.
When I asked him to stop, he said, "I will,
when you lose the baby weight."
-Very well. I must have imagined it.
